description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case formats, used across the application for UI consistency.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace. Returns original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, with proper handling of delimiters, apostrophes, and accented characters, for display purposes. Returns original value if not a string.
